test_tfp_compatible_distribution_normal: test the TFP-compatible distribution wrapper with a Normal distribution for event_shape, batch_shape, and sampling
test_tfp_compatible_distribution_mvn_dia: test the TFP-compatible distribution wrapper with a MultivariateNormalDiag distribution for shape and sampling correctness
test_tfp_compatible_distribution_categor: test the TFP-compatible distribution wrapper with a Categorical distribution for log_prob and prob methods
test_tfp_compatible_distribution_transfo: test the TFP-compatible distribution wrapper with a Transformed distribution using an Exp bijector
test_tfp_compatible_distribution_slicing: test the getitem slicing method on a TFP-compatible distribution with single element, range, and ellipsis indices
